decisions.reason: Having survived the first review while two similar condenser options were already pruned, this close-to-core fin cooler remains a low-cost option to keep open until demand is clearer.
The tube-liner solution fits the firm's retrofit and service business closely, so its downside cost is low while corrosion-repair upside remains attractive.
As a customizable multi-model air-cooler line that strongly matches the firm's integrated-solution strategy, it is the kind of option this firm would continue to back.
These repair inserts reinforce the lifecycle-service model and are inexpensive to keep in the portfolio while the firm continues to learn the depth of repeat service demand.
